_about: Public-domain Capel Molyneux (1804-1877), evangelical incumbent of Holy Trinity, Paddington, and St Paul's, Onslow Square, who later left the Church of England, for the Word Hoard: Baptismal Regeneration Compared with the Word of God (1842) and Gethsemane, lectures (1854). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 66 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

molyneux-baptismal-regeneration: Baptismal regeneration compared with the word of God and the standards of the Church of England (catalogued 1842)

_excluded.molyneux-other: Other Molyneuxes (William Molyneux of Dublin and others)
